resources.string: Ask for counter-arguments, a comparison or how a channel\'s view changed: SSI opens Belege, Vergleich or Zeitleiste. Every classification shows a word-for-word checked quote, else "nicht belegt"; SSI never says who is right. Export the report or save the research.

In the editor of "Eigenes": the pen draws Bézier shapes, the Form tab combines shapes (union, subtract, intersect, exclude) and masks images; in the Animation tab shapes can morph and elements can follow a drawn or recorded path.
